propositions: The fixture equivalence assertion required build_ticket_position_commit_map to succeed on first attempt, but the function explicitly returns empty map on any Git transient (nonzero rc, empty output, or process exception).

Runtime injection of rc=128/empty, rc=0/empty, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) each reproduced the observed sequence: first batched call returned {}, immediate identical replay succeeded with all 8 position-to-SHA pairs.
Deleting the previously suspected loose blob left both broad and narrow history walks healthy, refuting the prior ENOENT mechanism as cause of this recurrence.
The test harness lacked bounded Git-read recovery despite production callers using per-event fallback for transient Git failures already modeled in tests/_git_counts.py.

Fixture-only _fixture_batched_map seam added to both equivalence and optimization-count assertions, performs at most five exact resolver attempts, returns on first complete map, and raises persistent diagnostics (fsck, count-objects, object listing) on failure.
No changes to src/rebar production behavior; the fail-closed and per-event fallback semantics remain unchanged; fix is test-harness-only.
